text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stopped by a shrine with Tanino Gimlet,
who seemed to be feeling a bit out of sorts lately.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Here... can even someone like me,
wandering like a lost sheep...
find peace...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, praying to place in my next race, and...
also to lose a little weight...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, ah, Gimlet-chan?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence~ Are you visiting the shrine with your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I see... A prayer...
I wonder if it can purify the negative aura that clings to me as well?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Curse? Um, I don't really get it, but...
why not just go make an offering at the shrine?
It might at least give you some peace of mind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And with that, the three of us enjoyed a nice, relaxing shrine visit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, wish complete! What about you, Gimlet-chan?
Did you make a good wish?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
What did I ask of God, you ask...?
That's not an easy question to answer in a few words.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My ideals always resolve into a single logic.
That of a fleeting, yet intense flash of light...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Yes, in other words, vivid destruction...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Arma-ged...? Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That impact shall pin down the shadows of the moment!
Even after it passes, it will remain an eternal phantasm
etched deep into the minds of the people!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: However! I do not expect God to grant it! Instead, I declare it right here! My own desire—no, the destiny I must fulfill!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"O God! If you hear this voice of mine,
please watch over my journey!
History requires a witness!!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahahaaa!!
The way I live is a masterpiece of art in itself!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh...? What?
Your mood suddenly went totally crazy..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Tanino Gimlet, letting out a hearty laugh,
rung the bell with vigorous force.
And then...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*chime... whoooooosh...!*)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...! Did the wind... change?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Heh heh heh heh...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaha! You have my gratitude!! I almost forgot my very reason for being! From this moment forth, I shall achieve complete rebirth!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
??? I still don't really get it, but...
well, as long as you cheered up, that's fine~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――*snap! CRASH!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the rope snapped and the bell fell down.
Fortunately, it didn't hit anyone and no one was hurt, but...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Seems that Bronze Bell
wanted to give me a scare...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Creepy...
That feels kind of... ominous, doesn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet fell silent once more.
Her poor condition remained unchanged...
